column1: # This list buys DIAGNOSIS, NOT A DECISION. Under fail-closed (FR-009) every
# message here would be refused anyway, because none of it carries in-scope
# evidence. It exists so OFF_TOPIC can be counted apart from UNMATCHED, and
# that distinction is the only instrument the product has for judging whether
# failing closed is costing it real questions (FR-010, SC-007).
# Patterns are matched on word boundaries, like the hostile phrases.
